$comment: Motion B v2. The renewal window is a commercial ATTENTION window, not a prediction. The incumbent platform is REQUIRED context and is never claimed from timing alone. The EXPLANATION follows the established fact: a VMware-family incumbent may be described as displacement; any other established platform is modernization without naming VMware; a merely generic virtualization fact is never promoted into a named-incumbent claim. budget_reduction_target is not a disqualifier — cost pressure can strengthen the case.
